decision: Reject one-use burnt-bridge tracks as complete reversible contact-and-return solution; do not implement directional biases as a free-return apparatus; require specific physically accessible paid work/load cycle and independent stationary same-feed positive-surplus comparator.

future_only_hypotheses.statement: After accounting for track consumption and regeneration, forward biased motion may not yield positive retained load work.
Reverse transition plus track restoration requires finite input and cannot be represented as free reset.
Full cycle material provenance will reveal an external manufacturer for at least one essential constituent.
A physically accessible same-feed stationary converter may dominate lifetime net work once all costs are included.
Apparatus-independent rates will not match instrument-specific optical pulling transition rates without corrections.
